messages:
maria: quick note from onboarding tests — SDKs disagree on auth errors. python raises AuthExpired, go returns plain 401 text, js gives nested keys. this breaks retry and UI flows. can we land a tiny canonical error shape + language-native typed exceptions?

alex: yes. runtime emits a canonical JSON body; SDKs map to typed exceptions but keep raw body available.

sam: minimal fields propose: type, status, message, error_class, retryable, retry_after_seconds, hint_code, documentation_url. small and actionable.

linda: agree. error_class values: auth, permission, rate_limit, user_input, not_found, conflict, transient_server.

maria: streaming note: include optional stream_resume_token for mid-stream errors. SDKs expose StreamError with resume metadata.

qa-bot: test action: add a matrix that posts canonical error payloads to runtime and asserts each SDK surfaces matching error_class and retryable. add to nightly CI.

maria: example JSON for docs (dev-facing):

```json
{ "type": "RateLimitError", "status": 429, "message": "Too many requests", "error_class": "rate_limit", "retryable": true, "retry_after_seconds": 30, "hint_code": "reduce_concurrency", "documentation_url": "https://docs.redwood.ai/errors#rate-limit" }
```

linda: tiny copy nit: separate user-facing UI copy from developer logs. UI: 'Session expired — please sign in again.' dev log: 'AuthError: token expired (401)'.

sam: runtime mapping draft: 400->user_input(false), 401/403->auth/perm(false), 404->not_found(false), 409->conflict(false), 429->rate_limit(true), 5xx->transient_server(true). populate retry_after_seconds from Retry-After when present.

alex: SDK ergonomics: each SDK exposes a typed exception class (e.g., RateLimitError) with properties: status, raw_error, is_retryable. names should be idiomatic per language.

maria: i'll draft a short RFC + sample patches for py/go/js and a docs page. volunteers to coauthor? @alex for go/java, @linda for js/docs, @sam for runtime tests.

alex: i'll take go changes.

linda: i'll do js/docs.

sam: i'll add integration tests and CI gating.

maria: i'll open ticket and link RFC. thanks everyone :sparkles:
